verdict.rationale: Kit documents an official remote MCP server that exposes a creator's account (subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments) to MCP-compatible AI clients with read/write access. The docs explicitly say natural-language prompts like "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week" become real account actions. The main caveat is that this natural-language control runs through an external AI client rather than a built-in interface. Missing for 10: any native in-app natural-language assistant, detailed docs on which actions the MCP supports and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work as claimed.
